The DegV family proteins, in turn, are targets of hiiranlactone C, which may modulate their activity. This chain of interactions implies that Mesulfen could influence the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through the DegV family, potentially by affecting the transport activity of the latter. The evidence is supported by a moderate confidence score, suggesting that while there is a plausible pathway, further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between Mesulfen and Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1.
